title: GLSMs for non-polynomial deformations and generalized complete intersection Calabi-Yau manifolds
summary: Gauged Linear Sigma Models (GLSMs) have long been a key tool in understanding Calabi-Yau compactifications of string theory. While descriptions of complete intersections of polynomial defining equations have long been understood in this context, a full treatment of non-polynomial complex structure deformations has been absent from the literature. Likewise, the somewhat more exotic generalized complete intersection Calabi-Yau construction has resisted a GLSM description.
